characterization_method: manual (bypasses aigrids package's analyse.py / load_task(), which OOM-kills even at ~500GB allocated memory on HPC, likely due to loading full .h5 satellite arrays into memory instead of using HDF5 lazy/metadata access). Computed directly from the per-station availability_IDs/*_timestamps.csv files and station_features.csv, without touching the large .h5 files.

odd_space_area.split_basis: station-based spatial holdout, verified from station_features.csv 'test' column (14 train stations / 5 test stations out of 19)
odd_space_area.note: No separate validation station subset identified in the data; val fraction reported as 0 pending clarification. n_datapoints uses records where all 6 modalities are simultaneously available.

odd_space_point.note: Same caveat as odd_space_area. 'area' vs 'point' likely differ in spatial resolution of the prediction target rather than in split ratio, but this was not verified against package source.

odd_time_area.split_basis: UNVERIFIED - temporal split boundary is not present in any data file examined; it is determined internally by the aigrids package's own loading code, which was not inspected.
odd_time_area.note: n_datapoints reported (total records with all modalities available), but train/val/test split ratio is a placeholder pending confirmation from group leader or package source inspection.

odd_spacetime_area.split_basis: UNVERIFIED - combines the spatial holdout (verified) with an unverified temporal boundary
